findings.quote: 22:30. 22:45. 23:00. She logged each one on the quarter hour, and between them the channel hissed its flat open hiss, and nothing came down from above the col.
findings.claim: The draft invents an INSLOG number, 0459, for the 22:15 post check. Canon fixes the recovered line at 0447 (16:20 Tue) and the voice call at 0463 (02:52 Wed), so fifteen numbered lines separate them; quarter-hour post checks from 22:00 to 02:45 are nineteen lines on their own and overrun the call's number before the call arrives.
findings.fix: Strike the invented line number from the post-check entry, keeping the entry, the time and the log formatting.
